topic: Cerebras Built a Single Chip with 4 Trillion Transistors
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know the World's Largest Chip is 8.5 Inches? 🖥️

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Instead of slicing silicon wafers into hundreds of tiny chips, Cerebras uses an entire 300mm silicon wafer as a single giant AI processor with 900,000 compute cores.
